function colorize(text, c, enabled) {
  if (!enabled) return text
  const codes = {
    red: '31',
    green: '32',
    yellow: '33',
    cyan: '36',
    gray: '90',
    bold: '1',
    dim: '2',
  }
  const code = codes[c] || '0'
  return `\x1b[${code}m${text}\x1b[0m`
}
